name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and a bench or a sturdy box behind you. Place one heavy dumbbell across your hips. Put a folded towel or a pad between the dumbbell and your body to reduce pressure.
Lean back until your upper back rests against the bench near the top edge. Keep both feet flat on the floor, about shoulder width apart.
If the dumbbell rolls, steady it with both hands. Keep your core tight and your ribs down through the whole set.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Keep your gaze forward. Do not arch your lower back to reach higher. If your lower back rises before your hips do, stop the set.
Lower your hips until they touch the floor, then repeat. Do 8-15 repetitions and rest 60-90 seconds between sets.
